summary.result: The super flow concretes using recycled coarse aggregate were improved by substitution in the range of less than the fly ash content $20\%$ and recycled coarse aggregate content $75\%$ .
summary.background: The unit weight was $2,246{\sim}2,344\;kg/m^3$ , the unit weights of these concrete were decreased with increasing the content of fly ash and recycled coarse aggregate.
summary.method: The L type compacting was excellent in the fly ash content $10\%\;and\;20\%$ , but, it was showed in good in the fly ash content $30\%$ .
